svg.title: Proportional control of the water heater
svg.desc: The first command is 30 percent at 20 degrees Celsius. As the water warms the command falls to 21.43 percent and the water settles at 24.29 degrees, 10.71 degrees below the setpoint. After 30 kilowatts more heat loss at 60 seconds the water settles at 22.14 degrees with a 25.71 percent command.
svg.text: Proportional control of the water heater
Simulator run of this project · Kp = 2 %/°C · 0.1 s samples · numbers answer the predictions
Colder inlet water: 30 kW more heat loss
